resources.string: When your phone rings or a call starts, the TV pauses. After the call it plays again and the bar fades back in, if tutti paused it and the TV is still on it.
To pause the TV when your phone rings, tutti needs Android’s phone permission. It only reads whether the phone is ringing or in a call: never a number or a contact.
Without the phone permission, tutti can’t tell when a call starts. You can allow it in Android’s settings.
On, but this phone hasn’t allowed tutti to see calls yet.
Night and Voice on the bar and a lower volume guard, between two times you choose.
From %1$s to %2$s: Night and Voice on, and the volume guard at %3$d instead of %4$d. Afterwards everything goes back, except what you changed yourself. Applied whenever tutti is connected to the bar.
From %1$s to %2$s: Night and Voice on. Afterwards everything goes back, except what you changed yourself. Applied whenever tutti is connected to the bar.
Start and end are the same time, so it never applies. Pick two different times.
